shipped_rows.title_o: Relation of promoter methylation of the structural oxytocin gene to critical life events in major depression: A case control study

blind_target.evidence_quote: Recently, we found hypomethylation of OXT in patients with Major Depressive Disorder (MDD) compared to healthy controls (HC). Since the replicability of findings is a key point of criticism in (epi‑)genetic research, we aimed to confirm our previous findings in a pre-registered study (data was stored in a database prior to pre-registration) within a new sample of n = 85 patients with MDD and n = 85 HC.
blind_target.outcome_quote: In accordance with our previous study, we found hypomethylation of OXT in patients with MDD compared to HC.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The abstract explicitly confirms the original patient-control hypomethylation finding. The earlier paper is not identified by citation in the abstract.

luna_triage.reason: The abstract explicitly retests hypomethylation in a new MDD/healthy-control sample, but only calls the original “our previous study.” The supplied source has no reference list or citation identifying that paper, and its coding note says related earlier Sanwald papers could fit. Need the full-text reference/citation linking this finding to one specific original.
